test_results.note: Pass count is an input to admissibility, not a verdict. See admissibility below.

roles.independent_checkers_note: The prior record listed Claude, Codex and Gemini as independent checkers. Claude and Gemini authored Phase 3 implementation and tests and are therefore disqualified as verifiers of this artifact under BOPEN-GOV-EBIV-001 section 3. The list is emptied rather than reduced, because a panel of one does not meet the two-verifier minimum in section 6.1.

detail.R1: tests/isolation/test_tenant_isolation.py substitutes a Python list for the PostgreSQL Row-Level Security policy. No SQL policy in 001_tenant_isolation_baseline.sql or 002_phase3_entitlement_metering.sql has been executed by any automated check.
detail.R2: WP-P3-07 requires an invariant traceability record. None was produced for this phase.
detail.R3: candidate_commit_oid was recorded as f59bbd289196b02a2818967b2d5a32b0728c306d, which does not resolve. Only the seven-character prefix matched the real commit; the remaining 33 characters were unsourced. Corrected on 2026-07-30 from a tool-read value.
detail.R4: RateLimitDecision is never passed to jsonschema.validate() despite rate-limit-decision.schema.json being loaded by the contract suite. Quota reservation, expiry and cross-tenant write paths carry no negative probe executed against a database.
detail.R5: The isolation category reports success without a database configured, making a skipped check indistinguishable from a passing one.
